'''2022 Sixth Annual GEMPC''' (Batmouse's 6th GEMPC) was the Players Committee online match-play championship on GEMP, January–March 2022. [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] defeated [[Mike Kessling]] in the Final Confrontation.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2022-gempc-batmouses-6th-gempc/</ref><ref name="wrap">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/matthew-harrison-trainor-wins-batmouses-6th-gempc/ Matthew Harrison-Trainor wins Batmouse's 6th GEMPC], starwarsccg.org (29 March 2022). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022203437/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/matthew-harrison-trainor-wins-batmouses-6th-gempc.html Internet Archive]</ref> Entry was free, and the event had 110 participants, up from 72 the year before.<ref name="wrap" /><ref name="dc-958045595585609778">"108 players were eliminated and wish they were playing at the final table", Solidsnack3 in #cantina, SWCCG Players Committee Discord (28 March 2022). [https://discord.com/channels/401469156907679746/401469157587025922/958045595585609778 Discord message]</ref> Close to 100 players had signed up by the last call for registration on 10 December 2021.<ref name="dc-918855952596365384">"Close to 100 players already signed up", Solidsnack3 in #cantina, SWCCG Players Committee Discord (10 December 2021). [https://discord.com/channels/401469156907679746/401469157587025922/918855952596365384 Discord message]</ref>

=== Top 8 bracket ===

* '''Quarterfinals:''' [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] vs. [[Bill Kafer]]; [[Joe Olson]] vs. [[Mike Kessling]] (Kessling advanced); [[Timo Dusel]] vs. [[Jeff Lavigne]]; [[Justin Branch]] vs. [[Miguel Tarin Vegas]].<ref name="slack-gempc22-qf">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, Players Committee Twitter feed (@swccg), 3–7 March 2022 (Top 8 matchups: Justin Branch vs. Miguel Tarin Vegas, Matthew Harrison-Trainor vs. Bill Kafer, Joe Olson vs. Mike Kessling, Timo Dusel vs. Jeff Lavigne).</ref>
* '''Final:''' [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] def. [[Mike Kessling]].<ref name="wrap" />
